summary: A mountainous country of the South Caucasus, with a claim to be the first nation to adopt Christianity as a state religion. It regained independence from the Soviet Union in 1991.

events.note: Dated from the First Republic of Armenia, declared on 28 May 1918, the first modern Armenian state. Armenian kingdoms existed in antiquity and the Middle Ages. Armenia was a Soviet republic from 1920 to 1991.

events.label: Independence
events.note: Armenia declared independence from the Soviet Union after a referendum.
